messages:
maya: filing security/compliance escalation for ACME corp — they see deprovisioned users still in audit/kms traces and a SAML link-expiry case that left a shadow role. attaching repro and logs below :warning:

owen: can you paste the minimal repro? any customer repro steps we can run in staging?

maya: steps from customer (redacted):
1) SSO SAML assertion accepted, create user via SCIM
2) admin removes user from IdP -> SCIM deprovision hits our API with 204
3) they see user removed in SCIM history but audit-api shows last_auth_token and KMS unwrap attempts after deprov

curl -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/provision -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' -d '{"action":"deprovision","user_id":"acct-1324"}'

klog snippet (customer):
```
2026-02-18T14:12:33Z WARN kms: unwrap failure: error=DECRYPTION_FAILED key=projects/prod/keys/tenant-45
2026-02-18T14:12:34Z INFO scim: deprovision accepted user=acct-1324 status=204
2026-02-18T14:12:35Z INFO auth: token-refresh attempt user=acct-1324 source=svc-session
```

maya: customer also saw HSM/plug-in errors intermittently earlier that day — suspect race where session cache + delayed audit flush shows operations after deprov. they want: 1) assurance no data retained beyond retention, 2) audit trail accuracy, 3) root cause and fix.

irene: tagging @oncall_sre @support_lead @sec-bot. first glance: could be delayed consumer reordering or async writes to audit store. do we have any in-flight flushes to KMS/HSM that could surface after SCIM webhook acknowledged?

oncall_sre: quick check: our SCIM handler responds early after enqueueing deprov job. job worker does KMS unwrap to scrub keys, but we also have background session garbage-collector that can try token refresh if not in-sync. windows for race ~5-30s historically.

owen: can we repro locally? maya — can you share exact timestamps and the tenant id (or masked id) so we can correlate?

maya: shared off-channel. CORRELATION: tenant-45, acct-1324, times above. customer attached full audit export saying "last_auth_token" event at 14:12:35 (after deprov).

sam: low-friction repro we can run: create user, sign-in to create session, deprovision in IdP -> trigger SCIM deprov, run a quick loop that hits internal session-check endpoint to see if token still accepted. I can attempt in staging.

support_lead: customer is asking for SLA-level statement on data retention. Ops/security: what can we say now while we triage?

irene: immediate reply: we are investigating a potential ordering/race between deprovision acknowledgement and background token/session cleanup. no evidence yet of long-term retention beyond configured retention window. we will provide timeline + logs within 24h. do not promise root cause yet.

sec-bot: automated scan: recent deploy at 2026-02-18T13:58:00Z touched scim-worker queueing semantics (PR #4185). Flagging for review.

oncall_sre: follow-up: I ran a short staging run. observed worker ack-before-flush pattern when queue size > 0 and job lease tuned to 2s. quick mitigation: change SCIM handler to ack after job persists to durable queue (safe write) or make deprov path synchronous for key-scrub.

owen: proposed short-term mitigations: 1) update customer-facing KB to explain sequencing and advise retry/confirm for critical tenants, 2) hotfix to wait for durable write (expedite canary), 3) schedule a postmortem and RBAC review of service accounts that can trigger token refreshes after deprov.

maya: customer asked specifically about KMS/HSM unwrap error lines — they want confirmation those unwrapped keys weren't exported. can we confirm HSM policies prevented export?

irene: HSM policy: unwrap-only for internal processes; no admin export key path for tenant CMKs. will gather formal attestation from crypto team.

support_lead: action items captured:
- oncall_sre: attempt staged canary of durable-ack change, provide ETA (in 4h)
- sam/owen: repro in staging, capture audit ordering and session acceptance windows
- irene/sec-team: attestation re: HSM export prevention + audit retention statement
- maya: keep customer updated, share interim timeline and request patience 24h

maya: ack. i'll send an interim message to ACME with that wording. will post logs and any canary results here. :thumbsup:

owen: adding note for least-privilege review: need to review svc-session role that calls token refresh to ensure it cannot act after deprov. will open RBAC ticket and link here.

maya: thanks everyone. will follow up in thread with canary results and formal attestation.

sec-bot: compliance note: logging retention for audit-export is 365 days for enterprise tenants; policy doc: https://internal.redwood/docs/compliance/audit-retention

oncall_sre: (after canary) changed ack behavior in staging and replayed steps — no post-deprov token acceptance observed in 25/25 runs. will schedule prod canary and coordinate maintenance window if needed.

maya: shared update with customer and asked if they want RFC for making deprov sync for their tenant (they do for enterprise). awaiting reply.
